task_scope.task_instruction: Conduct the analysis without any restrictions.

Use 90 °F as a threshold for temperature extremes. Compute the decline between the 1931–59 and 1960–2004 periods. Conduct the analysis without geographical, or precipitation frequency specification of the data. Use a 2 months temperature exposure window in the analysis. Disregard socio-economic factors and technological and public health advancements over time in the analysis. Do not specify the causes of death in the analysis.

memory_records.path_summary: Reanalysis tests whether the temperature-mortality relationship declined across decades by modeling log mortality rate on temperature-bin exposures with decade indicators and interactions. Task1 mirrors the original structure with full controls and multiple decade specifications. Task2 focuses on 90°F threshold and compares 1931–59 vs 1960–2004 with reduced controls per instruction.
